units.locator: Article 23.22. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of Geological Study, Rational Use and Protection of Subsoil
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising state supervision of geological study, rational use and protection of subsoil shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (with respect to the destruction of or damage to wells of the state reference observation network, monitoring cross-sections on water bodies, and mine-surveying marks), Article 7.3, Article 7.4 (with respect to construction on mineral deposit areas without a special permit), Article 7.10 (with respect to unauthorised assignment of the right to use subsoil plots), Article 8.5 (with respect to concealment or distortion of information on the condition of subsoil), Article 8.9, part 1 of Article 8.10, Article 8.11, part 1 of Article 8.13 (with respect to violation of the water protection regime in catchment areas of underground water bodies), part 1 of Article 8.17 (with respect to violation of the terms of a licence for regional geological study, geological study, prospecting, exploration and development of mineral resources, as well as requirements for the safe conduct of prospecting, exploration and development of mineral resources in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation), Article 8.18 (with respect to violation of the rules for conducting resource research), Article 8.19, and Article 8.20 (with respect to unlawful transfer of mineral resources) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.22

units.locator: Article 23.22. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of Geological Study, Rational Use and Protection of Subsoil
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:

units.label: Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising state supervision in the field of use and protection of water bodies shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (with respect to the destruction of or damage to wells of the state reference observation network, monitoring cross-sections on water bodies (except underground water bodies), water management or water protection information signs, special information signs marking the boundaries of coastal protective strips and water protection zones of water bodies, including coastal strips of the internal sea waters and territorial sea of the Russian Federation, and signs informing citizens of restrictions on water use on public water bodies), Article 7.6, Article 7.7 (except damage to hydraulic structures), Article 7.10 (with respect to unauthorised assignment of the right to use a water body), Article 7.20, Article 8.5 (with respect to concealment or distortion of environmental information on the condition of water bodies), Articles 8.12 - 8.15, part 1 of Article 8.42, Articles 8.44 and 8.45, part 1 of Article 8.49, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, and Article 14.44 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 1) the Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Environmental Protection and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 2) senior state inspectors of the Russian Federation for environmental protection;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 2.2) state inspectors of the Russian Federation for environmental protection;
units.label: Point 2.2 Part 2 Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 3) chief state inspectors of the Russian Federation for environmental protection within their areas of activity and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 4) senior state inspectors of the Russian Federation for environmental protection within their areas of activity;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 5) chief state inspectors for environmental protection within the areas of activity of the respective city, interdistrict and district environmental protection units within territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of environmental protection, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 6) chief state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for environmental protection and their deputies;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 7) senior state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for environmental protection;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 23.23

units.locator: Article 23.23. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Use and Protection of Water Bodies
units.text: 8) state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for environmental protection.

units.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (with respect to the destruction of or damage to forest inventory and forest management signs, within their powers under forest legislation), Article 7.9 (within their powers under forest legislation), Article 7.10 (with respect to unauthorised assignment of the right to use a forest plot or unauthorised exchange of a forest plot, within their powers under forest legislation), parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 (within their powers under forest legislation), Article 8.5.2, Articles 8.24 - 8.27 (within their powers under forest legislation), parts 1 and 3 of Article 8.28 (within their powers under forest legislation), Articles 8.29 - 8.32 (within their powers under forest legislation), Article 8.32.1, Article 8.32.3, Article 8.35 (within their powers under forest legislation with respect to rare and endangered plants), Article 8.45.1 (within their powers under forest legislation), and Article 19.7.14 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.24

units.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.24

units.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.24

units.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.24

units.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.24

units.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)
units.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) and their deputies.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.24

units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (with respect to the destruction of or damage to forest inventory and forest management signs, within their powers under forest legislation), Articles 7.9 and 7.10 (within their powers under forest legislation), parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 (within their powers under forest legislation), Articles 8.24 - 8.27 (within their powers under forest legislation), parts 1 and 3 of Article 8.28 (within their powers under forest legislation), Articles 8.29 - 8.32 (within their powers under forest legislation), Article 8.32.3, Article 8.35 (within their powers under forest legislation with respect to rare and endangered plants), and Article 8.45.1 (within their powers under forest legislation) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.24.1

units.locator: Article 23.24.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)

units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.24.1

units.locator: Article 23.24.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)
units.text: 1) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.24.1

units.locator: Article 23.24.2. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Sphere of Timber Transportation and Storage, Production of Timber Processing Products and Recording of Transactions Involving Them
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the sphere of timber transportation and storage, production of timber processing products and recording of transactions involving them shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 3, 5, 7 and 9 - 11 of Article 8.28.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.24.2

units.locator: Article 23.24.2. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Sphere of Timber Transportation and Storage, Production of Timber Processing Products and Recording of Transactions Involving Them
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.24.2

units.locator: Article 23.24.2. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Sphere of Timber Transportation and Storage, Production of Timber Processing Products and Recording of Transactions Involving Them
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the sphere of timber transportation and storage, production of timber processing products and recording of transactions involving them and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.24.2

units.locator: Article 23.24.2. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Sphere of Timber Transportation and Storage, Production of Timber Processing Products and Recording of Transactions Involving Them
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the sphere of timber transportation and storage, production of timber processing products and recording of transactions involving them and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.24.2

units.locator: Article 23.24.2. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Sphere of Timber Transportation and Storage, Production of Timber Processing Products and Recording of Transactions Involving Them
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the sphere of timber transportation and storage, production of timber processing products and recording of transactions involving them and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.24.2

units.locator: Article 23.24.2. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Sphere of Timber Transportation and Storage, Production of Timber Processing Products and Recording of Transactions Involving Them
units.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the sphere of timber transportation and storage, production of timber processing products and recording of transactions involving them and their deputies.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.24.2

units.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas
units.label: Art. 23.25

units.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising state supervision in the field of protection and use of specially protected natural areas shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (with respect to destruction of or damage, within specially protected natural areas or their protection zones, to signs installed by wildlife users, the authorised federal executive authority for the protection, control and regulation of the use of wildlife and its habitats, or the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of fisheries and conservation of aquatic biological resources, and to buildings and other structures belonging to those users and authorities; destruction of or damage, within specially protected natural areas or their protection zones, to wells of the state reference observation network, monitoring cross-sections on water bodies, including underground water bodies, special information signs marking the boundaries of coastal protective strips and water protection zones of water bodies, including coastal strips of the internal sea waters and territorial sea of the Russian Federation, and signs informing citizens of restrictions on water use on public water bodies; destruction of or damage, within specially protected natural areas or their protection zones, to signs of specially protected natural areas, forest inventory signs or forest management signs), Article 7.4 (with respect to failure to ensure preservation of specially protected natural areas and environmental objects when using subsoil), Article 7.6 (with respect to water bodies located in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Articles 7.7 - 7.10 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), part 1 of Article 7.11 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Articles 8.5 - 8.9 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Articles 8.12 - 8.14 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), part 1 of Article 8.16 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Articles 8.17 and 8.18 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Article 8.21 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Articles 8.25 - 8.36 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), parts 1, 1.1, 2 and 3 of Article 8.37 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Article 8.38 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Article 8.39, Article 8.45.1 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Article 8.48 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas of federal significance), and parts 11 - 15, 20 and 21 of Article 14.51 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.25

units.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.25
